content.title: Search assets, metrics, and reports
content.description: An investment professional invokes the global search field from the header to begin finding assets, metrics, and reports, uses keyboard focus and shortcut behavior to access it quickly, and clears focus or the search overlay without destabilizing the field’s layout.
content.summary: Use global search from the header
content.value: Improves speed of access to portfolio and research context from anywhere in the terminal.
criteria: The global search field is labeled with the placeholder “Search assets, metrics, reports...”.
Focus changes the border to information blue and applies a subtle focus ring while keeping the search field visually stable.
Cmd/Ctrl + K focuses the search field and Escape clears focus or the search overlay.
